scope: Proposition 5.2 (Comparison of finite regular algebras) of the manuscript “Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations” (preprints/Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5fdf543649f1469a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let L be a complete noetherian normal local domain, and let A1, A2 be finite dominant local L-algebras that are regular local rings. Put di = rkL Ai. If these rings have positive characteristic and arise by completing local rings of varieties over a perfect field, then A⊕d2 1 ≃ A⊕d1 2 as L-modules. (5.4) The same conclusion holds in characteristic zero when the diagram is the completion of an algebraic finite diagram at a closed point over C. Finite products of the indicated local algebras can also be compared, using their total generic ranks.
